## Failed Tests — Detail

### ❌ Personal Lump Sum Trauma Cover › AC11: Trauma + Cancer combined SI over $250,000 (ANB 19) → cap error

**Acceptance Criteria (from user story):**

> AC11: Given Trauma + Cancer, When ANB 17-21 and combined Sum Insured exceeds $250,000, Then the combined-cap error is displayed.
> 
> Steps to reproduce:
> 1. New quote, ANB 19, activate Trauma, SI $250000.
> 2. Activate Cancer, SI $1 (combined > $250,000).
> 3. Read the error (Apply if needed).
> 
> Expected: combined-cap error mentioning $250,000.

**What was compared:**

| Check | Expected | Actual |
|---|---|---|
| Error shown for Trauma + Cancer combined SI over $250,000 (ANB 19) | combined-cap error mentioning $250,000 |  |

**Assertion failure:**

```
Error: AC11: expected $250,000 cap error. Got: 

expect(received).toBe(expected) // Object.is equality

Expected: true
```
